# Email Editor Project

This project is a Vue 3 application that uses the Unlayer email editor.

## Project Setup

### Install Dependencies
```bash
pnpm install
```

### Start Development Server
```bash
pnpm dev
```

### Backend
The backend is a simple Express server that saves and loads email templates. It uses Prisma as an ORM.

#### Backend Setup
```bash
cd backend
pnpm install
pnpm prisma migrate dev
pnpm start
```

## The problem
